data.name: Niazi
data.gender_notes: Niazi is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'na'aza', meaning 'to help' or 'to support'. In Islamic history, Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) is known to have given this name to his companion, Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas, for his unwavering support and assistance during battles. The name Niazi carries the meaning “Helper, supporter” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Niazi usually hope their child will grow to embody helper, supporter and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the importance of helping others and being a source of strength and support in times of need.
data.etymology: Niazi belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Helper, supporter.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Niazi total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
